messages.author: 63545f60f79347ce
messages.subject: Installation of camtrapR failed
parts:
I tried to install camtrapR from within R as follows:

install.packages("camtrapR")

but installation of several dependencies failed (see below).  I am using R version 4.2.2 installed on the Ubuntu 22.04 operating system.

Below are the dependencies which failed to install:

ERROR: dependencies ‘s2’, ‘units’ are not available for package ‘sf’
* removing ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/sf’
ERROR: dependencies ‘raster’, ‘sf’, ‘terra’ are not available for package ‘secr’
* removing ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/secr’
ERROR: dependencies ‘sf’, ‘secr’ are not available for package ‘camtrapR’
* removing ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/camtrapR’

The downloaded source packages are in
    ‘/tmp/RtmpGhOL7K/downloaded_packages’
Warning messages:
1: In install.packages("camtrapR") :
  installation of package ‘units’ had non-zero exit status
2: In install.packages("camtrapR") :
  installation of package ‘terra’ had non-zero exit status
3: In install.packages("camtrapR") :
  installation of package ‘s2’ had non-zero exit status
4: In install.packages("camtrapR") :
  installation of package ‘raster’ had non-zero exit status
5: In install.packages("camtrapR") :
  installation of package ‘sf’ had non-zero exit status
6: In install.packages("camtrapR") :
  installation of package ‘secr’ had non-zero exit status
7: In install.packages("camtrapR") :
  installation of package ‘camtrapR’ had non-zero exit status

messages.author: 63545f60f79347ce
messages.subject: Re: Installation of camtrapR failed
parts:
I solved the install problems by installing the dependencies directly from the c2d4u Ubuntu repository of CRAN as follows:

sudo apt update
sudo apt install r-cran-units
sudo apt install r-cran-terra
sudo apt install r-cran-s2
and so on...

The R package "camtrapR" was not found in the c2d4u repository; therefore, I installed "camtrapR" from within R (using  install.packages()) after the dependencies had been installed.
